security_audit.summary: Static matches are predominantly Markdown examples and documentation references, not executable behavior in this skill. The skill nevertheless guides users through real external operations, including project uploads, cloud deployment, publication, feedback submission, and URL-based capture; these require explicit user consent and credential review.

remediation.suggestion: Require a preflight file list and explicit confirmation before uploading. Exclude secrets and review generated archives.

remediation.issue: Deployment, destruction, publishing, and feedback have external side effects.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before each external or destructive action, and show the target account or destination.

remediation.issue: URL capture and callback targets create network trust boundaries.
remediation.suggestion: Validate URLs, warn on private or internal addresses, and require approval for non-example destinations.

remediation.issue: Ambient cloud credentials can authorize costly actions.
remediation.suggestion: Use least-privilege credentials, do not print secrets, and show the selected account and estimated impact before deployment.

content.value_statement: Video composition workflows can require many CLI steps and validation checks. This skill guides HyperFrames setup, preview, render, comparison, and supported cloud workflows.
actual_capabilities: Scaffold a HyperFrames project or capture a website as a starting point.
Run lint and check workflows to identify composition and browser-runtime issues.
Create snapshots and compare rendered output during visual iteration.
Preview, play, and locally render video compositions at draft or final quality.
Guide supported HeyGen Cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering workflows.
Help diagnose CLI, browser, build, and render failures.
limitations: It does not guarantee visual quality, accessibility, or production readiness.
Cloud rendering, deployment, publishing, and feedback can incur costs or share data.
It requires the HyperFrames CLI and any required browser or cloud credentials.
It cannot safely choose cloud accounts, deployment regions, or publication targets without user input.

use_cases.title: Create a first composition
use_cases.description: Scaffold a project, add assets, and run an initial lint and preview loop.

use_cases.title: Validate a release render
use_cases.description: Run checks, snapshots, and comparisons before creating a final local render.

use_cases.title: Plan a managed render
use_cases.description: Review inputs, credentials, costs, and confirmation steps before using cloud rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Start a local project
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new HyperFrames project for a 15-second product video. Use a non-interactive example and explain the next validation step.

prompt_templates.title: Check a composition
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the recommended HyperFrames lint and check workflow for this project. Summarize each issue and propose the smallest fix.

prompt_templates.title: Compare revisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Capture snapshots for the current composition and compare them with the approved baseline. Describe meaningful visual differences.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a cloud render
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a HeyGen Cloud render, but do not upload, deploy, publish, or submit feedback. First list files that could be shared, credentials needed, expected cost factors, and confirmation points.

output_examples.input: Check my composition before the final render.
output: Recommended workflow: run lint, then run check.
Result: two layout warnings and one missing asset reference require attention.
Next step: fix the asset reference, rerun check, then create a final preview.

output_examples.input: Prepare a cloud render without sending anything.
output: Preflight: review the project archive and exclude secrets or unrelated files.
Credentials: confirm the intended HeyGen account without displaying keys.
Action paused: explicit approval is required before upload or credit-consuming render.

best_practices: Run lint early and run check before final rendering.
Use snapshots and comparisons to review visual changes systematically.
Review files, account, cost, and destination before cloud, publish, or feedback actions.
anti_patterns: Do not run cloud deployment or destruction commands without explicit approval.
Do not upload project folders before checking for secrets and unrelated assets.
Do not treat a successful command exit code as proof that visual validation passed.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It guides HyperFrames CLI workflows for project setup, validation, previewing, rendering, and supported cloud operations.

faq.question: Can it render locally?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide local preview and render workflows when the required CLI and browser dependencies are installed.

faq.question: Does it deploy cloud infrastructure automatically?
faq.answer: It should require your explicit approval before deployment, rendering, destruction, publishing, or feedback submission.

faq.question: Will it expose my API keys?
faq.answer: It should use configured credentials without printing them. Review environment variables and local credential files before cloud actions.

faq.question: Can it capture a website?
faq.answer: Yes. URL capture is supported, but only use addresses you trust and approve.

faq.question: Does a successful check guarantee a finished video?
faq.answer: No. You should review the preview and rendered output for content, branding, timing, and accessibility.
